feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 7 September 2026 11:42am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 07 September 2026 at 11:40am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low to south of Iceland, with a frontal system affecting the Irish Sea today.


##Wind##

West or Southwest 4 or 5, increasing Southwest 5 or 6 early this afternoon, then veering West or Southwest 6 occasionally 7 later tonight or tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, gradually building moderate or rough.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain spreading from west this afternoon, clearing later in day or at first tonight. Scattered showers tomorrow.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, falling moderate at times in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West 6 occasionally 7, veering Northwest during the evening. Slowly decreasing Northwest 5 or 6 overnight into Wednesday, 4 or 5 during the morning.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, gradually falling slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Scattered showers, then fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
